title: Tray video sound read stays Reading forever when its continuation is dropped, so Send is refused for good
trigger: Attach an .mp4 to a tray, then within the ffprobe read close the chat window that started it or switch account (ComposerSends and TrayReads outlive both); reopen the tray
effect: check_tray_videos starts the read with spawn_scoped(...).detach(); on a closed window or a moved screen epoch ScopedApp::update returns Gone, send_box.sound.finish never runs, the path stays Read::Reading, is_unread is false so it is never re-read, tray_videos_checking stays true and Send says 'Checking the video, send again' until the file is removed from the tray
fix: Hold the read's Task in Read::Reading (dropped with the entry) or settle/forget Reading entries when the window or screen scope goes (a dropped continuation owes its cleanup); app-level reads must not use window/screen-scoped spawns

title: Tray media check and file thumbnail reads (and their 15 s give-up timers) are window/screen-scoped but settle app-level TrayReads, so Reading can stick
trigger: Attach a photo or video, or a picture sent as a file, then close the chat window that started the read or switch account before it lands; reopen that tray
effect: Both the worker continuation and the GIVE_UP_AFTER timer are spawn_scoped(...).detach() and return Gone, so Reads::media / Reads::thumbnails keep Reading{job}; tray_media_checks_pending / tray_thumbnails_pending stay true and Send is refused with 'Preparing the files' until the attachment is removed
fix: Same as c0-001: the Reading stage owns its Task and timer (Reading{job, task}) so the owner dropping them ends the stage; or spawn_app work that always settles

title: A file kept as a file (keep_as_file) flips the whole tray to send-without-compression for the next drop
trigger: Drop a very wide or narrow image (media_dimensions_valid false) or an animated webp so the media check calls keep_as_file (kind Document, FileOnly), leave a normal photo in the tray, then drop or pick another normal photo
effect: append_dropped_files computes as_files = any(kind==Document && media_kind_for(path).is_some()); the FileOnly attachment satisfies it, so the new photo is added as a Document (sent uncompressed) while the 'Send without compression' checkbox still shows unchecked (it requires all attachments Document)
fix: A tray-level SendMode enum {Compressed, AsFiles} stored with the tray (or at least skip file_only() attachments when inferring the mode)

title: 'Send without compression' is not stored: three readers infer it from attachment kinds with three different rules
trigger: Any tray mixing Document and Photo/Video kinds
effect: append_dropped_files uses any(Document with a media extension); composer_ui/mod.rs:650 uses can_send_as_files && all(Document); send_box_options.rs:79 composer_media_options uses all(Document) (true for an empty tray or a tray of plain files, which clears hd_photos). The mode is a derived guess that also changes when keep_as_file or the GIF rules change a kind
fix: One enum SendMode {Compressed, AsFiles} on the tray (ComposerSends slot), set by the checkbox and by pick_attachments(as_files)

title: A collectible lookup whose send fails is ignored: the tap is silently dead
trigger: Tap a collectible username or phone number while the chats path is inactive or the sender refuses the request
effect: open_collectible_info does `let _ = live.driver.request_collectible_info(lookup)`, request_collectible_info returns Err and stores no lookup, then open_box(CollectibleInfo) runs anyway; the box predicate needs lookup.info(), so nothing opens and no status note is posted (the Failed-lookup note exists only for TDLib errors, via pump_collectible_info)
fix: Match the Result: on Err post StatusNote::error (or store LookupStage::Failed); open the box only on Ok

title: LookupStage::Unsent is a construction-time stage that must be overwritten by the sender; is_loading counts it as loading
trigger: CollectibleLookup::new then any path that stores the lookup without request_collectible_info (tests do: collectible_info_ui_tests, on_screen_session_box_tests)
effect: A stored lookup in Unsent has no RequestId, nothing can answer it (answer/fail match only Loading), nothing leaves it, and is_loading() stays true. request_collectible_info is the only code that moves it to Loading, by writing the field directly
fix: Build the lookup as an argument (LookupSpec) and construct CollectibleLookup only as Loading(request) from the sender, so Unsent is unrepresentable

title: PhonePrompt {Asking, NotMine} is the 'No pressed' bool beside the actions set, reset by hand and written by the UI
trigger: Press 'No' on the phone suggestion in Settings; TDLib removes and re-adds suggestedActionCheckPhoneNumber
effect: The prompt stage is kept in step with membership of ACTION_PHONE in SuggestionFacts::actions by reset_phone_prompt (only add_action/remove_action), and ui/settings_phone_suggestion.rs:86 writes phone_prompt = NotMine directly. Works today; any other writer of actions (direct inserts) would leave a stale NotMine
fix: Make the phone action carry its stage (e.g. actions: BTreeMap<Action, ActionStage>, or PhoneSuggestion {Absent, Asking, NotMine}) with a method answer_no()

title: ChatUi::pending_delete is a one-shot hand-off slot: set and taken in the same call
trigger: Delete from selection mode (selection_mode.rs:935 sets it then calls confirm_delete)
effect: No frame ever reads pending_delete (the box is the kit alert; only demos set it without taking), so it is not state; confirm_delete's take() drops the confirm silently when there is neither a live client nor a demo session. The slot invites a future writer that leaves it set across an owner change
fix: Pass the DeleteConfirm as an argument to confirm_delete(confirm, cx) and delete the field

title: baseline: RowMenuFacts::is_saved_messages
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A fact about the chat (it is Saved Messages) read once when the row menu is built, not a request stage; still listed as debt rather than in implicit-state-allow.txt with a reason
fix: Move to implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason, or replace with a ChatRole enum (Saved, Normal) shared with ChatSwipeFacts/HeaderFacts

title: baseline: ChecklistDraft::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A user setting of the new checklist ('Allow Others to Mark As Done'), matched by the word 'done'; not a stage, but still listed as debt (same for Checklist, ChecklistDialog, ChecklistSend outside this file)
fix: Move the four entries to implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason (a TDLib permission mirrored as is)

title: Children no thread could reap are parked in a static Vec polled only by the next failure; reap_after_notice reports 'gone' when it was not reaped
trigger: std::thread::Builder::spawn fails (thread limit/OOM) in wait_in_background or reap_after_with
effect: PARKED is polled only when another wait_in_background spawn fails, so a parked child stays a zombie for the life of the process; in reap_after_with a failed spawn drops the notice sender at once, so reap_after_notice receivers (proxy_carrier helper exiting, web_app_ui close_with_notice) see Disconnected as 'helper gone' while the killed child may not be reaped yet (at most ~50 ms of polling, then left to the OS)
fix: Poll PARKED from a periodic upkeep or on every call, and send the notice only after try_wait reports exit (keep the sender in the parked entry)

title: ReplacementProbe::Probing names a background probe but holds no job or Task; the answer is matched by path only
trigger: Stage a replacement video, clear it and stage the same path again, or re-cut it to the same output path while the first probe runs
effect: probe_edit_replacement spawns a detached scoped task per call; finish_edit_replacement_probe accepts any answer whose path equals the staged one while Probing, so two probes of one path race and the older answer can settle a newer Probing (harmless while the file is unchanged, wrong if the file changed under the same path)
fix: Probing { job } (or { task }) held in the stage and compared on finish, as Reads::Reading{job} does

title: Screen-share pause edge is lost when its send fails
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide the shared window so set_screen_paused sends toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused, with the send failing (native send error)
effect: Only the answered-error arm (calls/error.rs:257) reverts screen_share_paused; a send_json Err just takes the request. Both flags (ActiveScreen::paused, ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused) now say paused, the early return 'if !changed && was == paused' blocks any resend, so Telegram keeps showing the share live (frozen picture, no paused mark) until the next edge
fix: Make the pause a stage of the share (GroupScreenShare::Sharing{paused: Told|Asking(RequestId)|Failed}) so a failed send leaves it unsent and the pump resends

title: baseline-style: the share's paused mark is kept three times by hand (skip 'stays the bool beside it' does not hold)
trigger: set_screen_paused, pump_shared_screen (wanted None), stop_sharing_screen, toggle_group_call_screen_share, screen_chooser demo and the error arm each write screen_share_paused with the share stage
effect: No bug today; ActiveScreen::paused, ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused and GroupScreenShare change together by hand. Section 8 (is-02 Review fixes, Merge) keeps the bool because it is 'written with the share's stage', an effort reason
fix: GroupScreenShare::{Off, Pending, On{paused}} (one value); CallScreen reads it instead of holding its own paused

title: Call microphone, shared-screen and level-tap failures are never shown to the user
trigger: Join a group call with the microphone unavailable, or start a screen share whose capture fails or whose engine is not ready within 10 s
effect: CallScreen::error, CallCapture::error, CallAudio::error and ConnectDriver::group_call_level_error are documented as 'the call window's note' but have no reader outside tests and pump_call_media's change detection (grep over src/ui finds none). The share just stops (Share::Ended) or the mic stays silent with no message
fix: Put the failure on the call (ActiveGroupCall/ActiveCall error line) or read these in the call window

title: EngineWait::{Idle, Waiting} is Option<Instant> inside Share::Picked, reset by hand
trigger: Pick a source while the engine has no frame sender
effect: Two-variant enum beside the real stage: pump_shared_screen sets wait back to Idle by hand when wanted is None (call_screen.rs:557) and close_active builds Picked{wait: Idle}; the Running stage has no equivalent
fix: Share::Picked{since: Option<Instant>} set by one transition, or Share::WaitingForEngine{pick, since}

title: Two driver timers have no deadline in next_deadline: the 10 s engine wait and the 5 s level-tap reopen
trigger: Pick a screen source when the engine never offers a sender, then leave the app idle; or let the raw level tap fail in a group call
effect: EngineWait::expired is only evaluated when the pump runs; flood_retry.rs next_deadline lists call_audio_deadline (Open only) and call_capture.until_reopen but not these two, so the share reads as live-with-nothing-sent, and CallAudio::Failed is not retried, until some unrelated wake
fix: Report both from next_deadline (CallScreen::until_wait_ends, CallAudio::until_reopen)

title: A picked source (or Ended error) outlives its call and is used by the next call
trigger: Choose a source in the screen chooser, never start sharing (or end the call before the share runs), then start a share in another call
effect: pump_shared_screen with wanted None only resets Picked's wait; Picked{pick} and Ended{error} stay in the driver. call_screen_source_available() (calls/mod.rs:194) then reports a source for the new call without the chooser, and the old source is captured. Only Running is cleared with the call (close_active(false))
fix: Drop Picked/Ended when the call that wanted them is gone (Farewell of the call), keyed by CaptureTarget

title: Own speaking edge is lost when setGroupCallParticipantIsSpeaking fails to send
trigger: Speak in a group call while the sender returns an error for that one request
effect: SpeakingTracker::update records last_sent before the send; a send_json Err is returned from pump_call_audio and swallowed by request_tick (unwrap_or(false)), so the tracker thinks TDLib knows. Others see you stuck speaking or silent until the 500 ms refresh or the next edge
fix: Tracker records a send only after send_speaking returns Ok, or keeps SpeakingSent::{Unsent, Told(bool)}

title: CallAudio::speaking mirrors SpeakingTracker's speaking state and is reset by hand in three places
trigger: pump_call_audio sets speaking false when not wanted, on a tap error, and from update.speaking
effect: No bug today; speaking, tracker.last_sent and the Tap stage must move together
fix: Read speaking from the tracker (one value), reset only through tracker.reset()

title: Login-URL button: login_url_request and last_login_url_info are two Options that form one stage, filled before the send
trigger: Press a login-URL button when the send fails (send_login_url_info / send_login_url)
effect: The context is written before send_json_request and not cleared when it returns Err, so a stale LoginUrlRequest stays until the next press; it is also taken by hand in the error arm (bots/error.rs:210), poll_drains.rs:260 and session_outcomes.rs:26. The answer is matched by purpose, not by the RequestId
fix: LoginUrlStage::{Idle, Asking{request, context}, Answered{info, context}}

title: BotLookup is three Options (exact, mine, global) kept in step, and a refused lookup reads as 'no match'
trigger: Type a username on the Chatbots screen; one of the three searches is refused
effect: done() is 'all three Some'; apply_business_extra_error stores Some(None)/Some(vec![]) for a failed part, so a refusal and an empty result look the same and nothing is shown (return true without setting business.error)
fix: BotLookup::{Idle, Asking{generation, exact, mine, global: Fetch<..>}} with Fetch::Failed per part

title: One installed-backgrounds Fetch serves both the light and dark theme list
trigger: Open Appearance in the light theme (list fetched with for_dark_theme=false), switch the app theme to dark, open Appearance or the chat look box again
effect: fetch_installed_backgrounds(for_dark_theme) returns Ok(None) unless the Fetch is Idle, and the Fetch is not keyed by theme, so the dark gallery shows the light list (and the reverse) for the rest of the session
fix: Fetch keyed by theme (HashMap<bool, Fetch<..>>) or refetch when the theme differs

title: installed_backgrounds begin() is called twice and the request is never recorded; the answer is matched by purpose
trigger: Open the wallpaper page
effect: Fetch::begin leaves Loading{request: None}; Fetch::sent(extra) is never called, so the answer and the error act for GetInstalledBackgrounds by purpose (chats/error.rs:34, chats/apply.rs:453) and dedupe scans requests.pending for the purpose (backgrounds.rs:25). The second begin() at line 50 does nothing
fix: Call installed_backgrounds.sent(extra) once and match answers on the held RequestId; drop the second begin()

title: Inline query slot is Loading without the request; answers are matched by (chat, bot, first_page)
trigger: Type '@bot query', then change the query while a page is in flight
effect: InlineQuerySlot::fetch Loading holds no RequestId; apply_inline_query_results and the error arm compare chat_id, bot_user_id and the stage, and has_inline_query_in_flight dedupes by (chat, bot). A first-page send failure also writes None over a Loaded slot of the previous query (bots.rs:663)
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading{request: RequestId, query}; apply only when the id matches

title: ComposerSnapshot holds attachment and album as two fields; 'empty when attachment is the single send' is by hand
trigger: Capture a send with a single attachment or an album
effect: attachment: Option and album: Vec are exclusive by convention (is_album, needs_media_prep, prepare read both; PreparedMedia::prepare derives 'alone' from album.is_empty())
fix: SendContent::{Text, Single(ComposerAttachment), Album(Vec<..>)}

title: 'Send without compression' on then off turns a soundless video or edited GIF into a plain video
trigger: Add a soundless mp4 (GifMode::Gif) or a video edited to a GIF, tick Send without compression, untick it, send
effect: set_send_as_files(true) calls set_gif(false) (attachments.rs:107); the way back for media restores only kind (attachments.rs:109-114), never set_gif(true), and extras.edits.gif stays true. The file goes out as a video, not an animation (the editor copy has lost its sound)
fix: Keep the GIF choice as GifMode only in one place and derive it from edits; restore it with the kind

title: AttachmentExtras: gif, source, edits, start_timestamp and path are one video-edit decision stored in five fields
trigger: Save the video editor (ui/video_editor.rs:535-548)
effect: gif is computed from edits.gif && has_audio, start_timestamp from edits, source is Some only if edited, path is the copy; set_gif and the tray code change gif alone, so they can disagree with edits
fix: VideoPrep::{Untouched, Edited{source, edits}} with gif and start_timestamp derived

title: Any getInstalledStickerSets answer wipes SuggestFor::Asked via mem::take
trigger: Type a trailing emoji so sticker suggestions load (suggest_for = Asked(emoji)), then open the sticker panel or anything else that refreshes installed sets; the answer lands
effect: std::mem::take(suggest_for) runs for every installed-sets answer and only WaitingForSets is acted on, so Asked(emoji) is reset to Nothing; sticker_suggestions_shown reads suggest_for.emoji() and hides the loaded suggestions row, and the emoji is asked again
fix: match on &suggest_for and replace it only when it is WaitingForSets

title: Send in one window drops another slot's waiting draft save
trigger: Type in a chat window (its quiet-window save is armed), then within a second send a message in the main window (clear_draft_after_send) or by the agent (clear_draft_after_agent_send -> cancel_pending_draft)
effect: pending_draft.take() / cancel_pending_draft() discard the held draft of whichever slot it was, not only the sending chat's: the chat window's typed text is never saved (cancel_pending_draft_of exists for this and is not used); in clear_draft_after_send the other slot's dirty mark is also left set so drafts from other devices are ignored for it
fix: use cancel_pending_draft_of(chat_id) in both, or settle the other slot first as note_composer_content_in does

title: A failed send in maybe_decline_busy_calls drops the rest of the drained queues
trigger: created_call_discards or busy_decline_queue hold more than one entry and a discardCall send fails (client closing)
effect: both queues are taken whole with mem::take and the loop returns on the first error, so the remaining calls are never discarded or declined and nothing retries them; the caller keeps ringing
fix: drain one entry at a time (pop_front) and put back the entry and the rest on error, as maybe_finish_leave_deletes does

title: accept_call can send a second acceptCall and answer_failed is matched by call id, not request
trigger: Click Accept twice (or accept while the first acceptCall is in flight) on a Pending incoming call
effect: accept_call only requires CallState::Pending, which stays Pending after the first send (CallProgress::Answered); a second acceptCall goes out. The second answer's error calls progress.answer_failed(call_id) which resets Answered to Idle by call id, so the call is treated as ringing again (and not as answered at close) while the first accept may still land
fix: refuse accept_call while progress is Answered{call_id}, and carry the accept RequestId in Answered so only its own answer clears it

title: data_storage_dirty is cleared before the save and its failure is dropped
trigger: Auto-download presets seed the per-network settings and the disk write fails (full disk, read-only folder)
effect: the dirty mark is reset first and the save result is discarded with let _, so the seeded settings are never retried and are lost on restart
fix: clear the mark only after save_data_storage_prefs returns Ok

title: Early ? in ingest skips one-shot continuations that nothing re-runs
trigger: run_post_ingest_pumps or maybe_continue_boost returns a send error on the envelope that makes the account Ready or completes a loadChats page
effect: became_ready work (preload forums, story paging, notification sounds, quick replies) and the load_chats_ok next-page send are skipped; was_ready is true on the next ingest so became_ready never fires again, and main paging only continues from an ok answer of an in-flight LoadChats, so the chat list stops paging
fix: run the Ready kickoff and paging continuations before fallible pumps, or record a pending kickoff stage that chat_list_tick retries

title: AI composer answers share one slot for all windows, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Ask AI to fix/compose text in the main window and in a chat window; both answers land in one poll batch before either window's upkeep drains
effect: messages.ai_composer_text / ai_composer_blocks is a single Option, written with = Some(..); the first window's answer is replaced and never applied, its ai_ask stays waiting
fix: queue answers keyed by the asking window and RequestId, or keep the answer in the window's own ask stage

title: Community fetches sit in Fetch::Loading{request: None} and are answered by purpose
trigger: joined, owned_bots, add_chat_requests and member_chats are set Loading with request None; apply_communities_payload/apply_communities_error match the answer on pending.purpose (and community id), not on the RequestId the stage holds
effect: a late answer of a dropped or replaced request (e.g. one forgotten by reset_add_chat_requests and asked again) is applied to the newer Loading; is_loading() guards also stay true if the request is lost
fix: call Fetch::sent(extra) after sending and apply answers through Fetch::answered/failed with the RequestId

title: CallPrivacyAsks stage is only written by driver methods nothing in production calls
trigger: fetch_call_privacy and set_call_privacy have no non-test callers; the UI loads and sets the rules through fetch_privacy_rules / PrivacySettingKey
effect: calls.privacy_asks never leaves Idle in a real session, so privacy_loading()/privacy_error() are dead, and privacy_allow_calls / privacy_p2p are a second copy of the privacy rule detail (written optimistically by set_call_privacy, set by session_privacy_data and settings apply)
fix: delete the dead driver methods and the duplicate fields, read the call rules from the privacy rules store

title: close_held_until is a close stage kept beside Session::shutdown
trigger: begin_close with a hang-up pending: close_held_until = Some(deadline) while Session::shutdown stays Running until release_close sends request_close
effect: for up to 500 ms the account is closing but chats_path_active() is true, so ingest can still start requests, accept a queued swap call or open work for an account on its way out
fix: make Held{until} a ShutdownPhase variant so chats_path_active() and the hold are one value

title: request_logout has no re-entry guard while a logOut is in flight
trigger: Confirm Log out twice (or from two surfaces) before TDLib leaves Ready
effect: auth stays Ready, so a second logOut is sent; logout_sent again settles the account's requests, bumps the generation and replaces auth_state.logout_request, so the first answer no longer matches
fix: refuse request_logout unless shutdown is Running and logout_request is None, or make logout a stage of ShutdownPhase

title: createPrivateChat is guarded and answered by purpose, for all users at once
trigger: Click a user button / Saved Messages while another createPrivateChat is in flight, or two keyboard-user buttons quickly
effect: has_purpose(CreatePrivateChat) returns Ok(None) with no feedback, so the second click does nothing; the answer opens whichever chat answers (created_chat matched on purpose in ingest), not the user asked for
fix: key the guard and the open-on-answer by the user id carried in the pending request

title: Withdraw holds the in-flight request twice: Withdraw::request (Option set after the send) and WithdrawStep::PasswordSending(RequestId)
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, then submit the password: send_withdrawal writes withdraw.request, then submit_withdrawal_password writes step PasswordSending(request) separately
effect: two fields that must change together; takes_answer has to compare both; request is None between Some(Withdraw) creation and the send
fix: carry the RequestId only in the step variants (Checking(RequestId), PasswordSending(RequestId)); drop Withdraw::request

title: open_starref_join leaves the found-programs list Idle and never asked when the connected-programs send fails
trigger: Open the affiliate join page while the first send (getConnectedAffiliatePrograms) is refused: fetch_connected_programs(false)? returns early, fetch_found_programs is never sent
effect: 'All programs' list stays empty with no spinner and no Retry (retry_starref_programs only acts on PageLoad::Failed); only reopening the page asks
fix: send both lists independent of each other and fail the unsent one (inspect_err sets PageLoad::Failed) so Retry shows

title: join_affiliate_program swallows a refused send: returns Ok(()) after resetting the stage to Open
trigger: Press Join Program while the sender refuses the request
effect: caller (UI) sees success and shows no error; box silently stays open
fix: return the send result (or push an EarnState note) when the stage is reset

title: EarnPage::ton / stars (Load::Loading) carry no RequestId; TonStats/StarStats answers and errors are matched by peer only
trigger: Open the revenue page of a peer, close, reopen same peer (open_earn_page replaces the page and re-sends) while the first TonStats/StarStats answer or error is still in flight
effect: a stale answer (or an error toast/Failed) from the first open lands on the second page's Loading stage, then the second answer overwrites or is ignored; Failed can show while a newer request is still out
fix: Load::Loading(RequestId) and compare with the pending id like ton_history.load.waits_for

title: refresh_gift_collections_if_stale clears the Stale mark to Idle before the refetch; a refused send loses the mark
trigger: Add or remove a gift in a collection (collections_fetch becomes Stale); refresh_gift_collections_if_stale sets Idle then fetch_gift_collections returns Err before it sets Loading
effect: collection tabs/counts stay out of date until the gifts list is reopened; compare refresh_received_gifts_if_stale, which calls gifts_op.refetched() on the same failure
fix: enter Loading only after the send, or restore Stale / go to a Failed stage on Err

title: begin_gift_manage ignores a refused getGiftCollections; collections_fetch stays Idle with no failure shown and no retry
trigger: Open a gifts list while the sender refuses the request: `let _ = self.fetch_gift_collections(owner)`
effect: collection tabs never load for that open; nothing re-asks until the list is reopened
fix: CollectionsFetch::Failed stage (or Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>>) set on a refused send, with Retry

title: CollectionsFetch::Loading carries no RequestId; settle() on any collections answer/error of an earlier owner ends the new owner's Loading
trigger: Open owner A's gifts list, switch to owner B's before A's getGiftCollections answers: reset_for_owner sets Idle, B's fetch sets Loading, A's late answer/error calls settle()
effect: B's collections look settled (Idle) while its request is out; Stale mark/refresh logic can send a duplicate
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } matched against the pending id

title: GiftManageState::deleting (Option<String>) is a second slot for the deleteGift in flight, beside hub.gifts_op (request) and PaymentsPurpose::DeleteGift
trigger: Delete a received gift: send_gift_mutation begins gifts_op, then the driver writes deleting after the send (the demo path in gift_manage_ui.rs writes it too)
effect: two fields that must change together; answer/error must clear both; demo and live write it from different places
fix: carry the gift id in the gifts_op stage variant (Mutating { request, kind: Delete(id) })

title: The per-owner/per-collection gifts list reset is written out by hand twice (select_gift_collection and premium_hub open): gifts, gifts_total, gifts_offset, gifts_page, gift_notice, gift_view select/confirm, flow, note
trigger: Switch collection tab versus open another owner's list
effect: a field added to one reset is missed in the other (rule 5: resets happen in one place)
fix: one GiftsList value replaced whole (list = GiftsList::new(owner, collection))

title: SendGiftState keeps open: bool, selected, stage and recipient in step by hand (close_send_gift, select_send_gift and open_send_gift_to each reset a different subset)
trigger: Close the send-gift box while a sendGift is out, reopen for the same recipient
effect: open=false while stage=Sending; reopening only flips open back; selected was cleared by close but stage kept
fix: SendGiftState as an enum Closed / Open { recipient, selection, stage } so Closed cannot hold Sending apart from the recipient

title: refetch_topic after read-all mentions/reactions drops a refused getForumTopic send silently (let _) and has no stale mark
trigger: Mark all mentions as read in a topic while the second send is refused
effect: topic badges stay at the old unread-mention/reaction counts until another update
fix: keep a stale mark per topic that the next ingest retries, or apply the read locally

title: fetch_folder_share returns early when the invite-links send fails, so the chats half (GetChatsForFolderInviteLink) is never begun and stays Idle
trigger: Open Share Folder while the first send is refused
effect: links show an error with Retry but the chats list stays Idle/blank (no spinner or error) until Retry re-runs both
fix: send both halves, failing each independently, instead of `return Err` after the first

title: flood_attempts entries (and the sender's retained json) leak when a re-sent request is swept or taken without any answer
trigger: A read gets a 429, is re-sent after the wait (entry removed from flood_retries), then is dropped by sweep_stale_requests / take_purpose before TDLib answers
effect: the flood_attempts map entry for that RequestId is never removed (small leak); the retained json is only freed on the next answer
fix: derive attempts from the retry entry (attempts inside FloodRetry/request stage) so dropping the request drops the count

title: Trending emoji paging keeps trending_offset (offset of the page in flight), trending_next_offset, trending_total and trending_has_more as four loose fields written by hand at select_emoji_set_tab, more_trending_emoji_packs and accept_trending_emoji_sets
trigger: Open Trending, scroll to load more, switch tabs and back, or have a more-page fail
effect: the answer reads trending_offset to decide replace vs append; a failed/dropped page leaves trending_offset pointing at the failed offset
fix: one Paging value: Start / Next { offset } / Asking { request, offset } / End, with the answer matched by RequestId

title: GIF search page offset lives in GifPanel::search_offset and search_next_offset (Strings) outside the GifList::Search stage; written by hand in search_gifs and maybe_search_gifs
trigger: Search GIFs, scroll for more pages, start a new search
effect: search_gifs clears three string/vec fields by hand next to search_begun; paging fields can disagree with the stage
fix: put offset/next_offset/results inside GifSearch (the stage) so a new search replaces them whole

title: claim_account_owner sets claimed_owner = Some(me) before the claim runs; a failed owner-file save is only eprintln'd and never retried
trigger: Sign in on an account folder where account_data::claim returns owner_error (disk full, read-only folder)
effect: claimed_owner stays Some(me) so the claim is not retried this run; the owner file is missing, so the next start cannot tell whose folder it is and drops what is in it
fix: set claimed_owner only after the claim succeeded (or hold a Claim stage: Unclaimed / Claimed(user) / Failed) and retry on the next ingest

title: The deep-link stage is reset and rewritten by hand outside its transitions: chats_state.deep_link = None here, and DeepLinkFlow { stage, from_agent } built directly in src/ui/deep_links.rs (lines 107, 179, 540); the invite preview is also held a second time in links.flow.invite()
trigger: Click a t.me link while an invite preview is up, or cancel the invite box
effect: the session stage and the UI's own copy of the preview are kept in step by hand (ask + deep_link = Some, take_invite + deep_link = None); from_agent is dropped or re-derived at each write
fix: one owner of the flow with start/enter/cancel methods only; the UI box reads the stage and cancel calls a single cancel_deep_link(generation); move deep_link_seq into the flow

title: ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused (bool) is a substate of GroupScreenShare::Sharing, reset by hand at five sites (controls.rs:56, call_screen.rs:561/647/691, screen_chooser.rs:596) and by the pause error arm; GroupScreenShare::Starting { answer: String } uses an empty string as 'answer not arrived'
trigger: Share the screen, hide the shared window (paused = true), stop the share or fail the start
effect: paused can stay true while screen_share is Off/Starting if one reset site is missed; the tile then shows a paused share that is not there; empty String doubles as 'no answer'
fix: GroupScreenShare::Sharing { paused: bool } (or Paused), Starting { request: RequestId, answer: Option<String> }, and Failed(String) in place of screen_share_error

title: load_more_group_call_participants has no in-flight guard and no stage: every click on 'Show more' sends another loadGroupCallParticipants; its error arm is ignored
trigger: Click 'Show more' repeatedly in a call with 100+ participants, or while offline
effect: duplicate paging requests, no spinner or error, button gives no feedback
fix: a Paging stage on the call (Idle / Loading(RequestId) / Failed) checked before sending, matched by RequestId

title: baseline: ActiveGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (also read in conference.rs:349 and ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants) is still a stage-named bool; it is in implicit-state-allow.txt as TDLib's own report
trigger: n/a (no bug today)
effect: stays on the register as the allowed mirror of groupCall.loaded_all_participants; load_more has no paging stage beside it (see c3-019)
fix: keep as mirrored TDLib fact; put the paging stage (Idle/Loading/Failed) in its own value

title: A conference join is held in three places kept in step by hand: Session::calls::pending_conference, ConnectDriver::conference_crypto (Joining/Call key) and the engine instance under PENDING_CONFERENCE_KEY with its group offer
trigger: Accept a conference invitation, then the answer errors, the offer fails or the account switches
effect: abandon_conference_join and note_conference_answer each clear a different subset (Session pending vs driver crypto vs engine/offer); a missed one leaves a provisional engine instance or a bound crypto behind
fix: one ConferenceJoin value owned by the driver (request, key, crypto, offer) replaced whole; the Session keeps only what the UI reads

title: request_giveaway_options resets a refused premium/stars send to Fetch::Idle instead of Failed; the caller ignores the Err and nothing asks again
trigger: Open the new-giveaway form while a send is refused (disconnected): options.premium/stars go back to Idle
effect: the form shows no prices, no error and no Retry; options are only asked once at form open
fix: Fetch::Failed with the error line and a Retry that calls request_giveaway_options

title: GramWithdraw::Password { request: Option<RequestId>, error } is Idle (None) and Sending (Some) in one variant; can_submit() is request.is_none()
trigger: Collect in My Grams, submit the password
effect: an Option used as a started flag inside a stage; connect/grams.rs rebuilds the whole value from the send result at submit time
fix: GramWithdraw::{PasswordIdle { error }, PasswordSending(RequestId), SecurityCheck { later }}

title: preload_craft_lists stops at the first refused send with `?`: when the candidates page fails to send, the 'on sale' list (craft.market.load) is never begun and stays Idle
trigger: Open the craft box while the first send is refused
effect: 'Your gifts' shows an error with Retry; the 'on sale' list stays Idle (blank), and retry_craft_listings only acts on an error() so it can never be retried until the box is reopened
fix: send both lists independently; fail each unsent one

title: follow_gift_auction drops the old follow without checking the closeAuction send: follow is set to None whether or not CloseAuction left
trigger: Switch from one auction box to another (or close) while the sender refuses the follow(false) request
effect: the server keeps sending auction updates for the old gift (session keeps applying them) while Quill believes nothing is followed
fix: AuctionFollow::Closing { gift_id, request } until the close answers or fails

title: set_direct_topic_read sends the marked-as-unread toggle, then `?` returns if the view_messages send fails, so the two halves of 'Mark as read' are not one step
trigger: Mark a conversation as read when the second send is refused
effect: the manual mark is cleared but the unread count stays; the Result says it failed though half went out
fix: report the partial send, or send the view first and the mark second

title: Undo of pending live-story Stars drops the local pending value before the remove request is sent; a failed send leaves the Stars pending on TDLib
trigger: Tap the Stars button on a live story, tap Undo while the connection to TDLib is down (send_json fails), then tap Stars again and let it commit
effect: The toast says undone and the pending amount is gone locally, but TDLib still holds the first taps; the next commit spends more Stars than the viewer sees. Every other send in this file (commit_reaction/commit_failed, AddPendingReaction add_failed) puts the stage back on a failed send; Undo does not
fix: Send first, then take the pending value (or restore it on Err), as live_story_reaction_tick does with commit_reaction/commit_failed

title: Stars burst animations are only (re)asked from the tail of maybe_fetch_live_story_extras, so an early return skips the retry
trigger: Open a live story; the first getCustomEmojiReactionAnimations send fails (live_story_request returns Err, live_bursts stays Unasked) or its answer errors (apply_live_story_error sets Unasked); streamer, donors and senders are already begun, so want is all false and the function returns before maybe_fetch_live_bursts
effect: No Stars effect bursts for this story; the retry comes only with the next Join. LiveBursts::Requested also holds no RequestId, and the answer is matched by purpose, so a dropped request leaves it Requested for the session
fix: LiveBursts::{Unasked, Requested{request: RequestId}, Loaded, Failed} asked from its own ingest step, not from the tail of the extras fetch

title: RtmpStage::FetchFailed is a stage whose only exit is the UI writing calls.rtmp_start = None from elsewhere
trigger: getVideoChatRtmpUrl fails; the stage becomes FetchFailed and waits for ui/dialogs/rtmp_stream.rs:461 to drop the whole process by hand; begin_rtmp_start for the same chat returns Ok early while the stale process is there, so no retry is sent
effect: If the UI upkeep does not run (box closed in another window, lock) the dead process stays and a second Stream with... for that chat opens a box that never gets a URL until close_rtmp_start runs
fix: begin_rtmp_start treats FetchFailed as absent and starts a new Fetching; the failure toast is taken once and the stage owner removes itself on the answer

title: check_group_username bumps check_generation before the send; a failed send leaves UsernameCheck::Checking with its answer now stale
trigger: Type the link in the group Type box (check 1 goes out, state Checking), type again while TDLib is disconnected (check 2: generation bumped, send_json_request fails, check not updated), reconnect
effect: Answer of check 1 is dropped as an older generation (apply_group_username_check / apply_group_type_error compare generation), so the field stays Checking with the spinner until the next keystroke sends a new check
fix: Move the generation into UsernameCheck::Checking{generation,..} and bump it only when the send succeeded (or put the stage back on Err)

title: Boost box answers (getAvailableChatBoostSlots, boostChat) are matched by purpose and chat id, not by a RequestId held in BoostWork
trigger: Press Reassign (boostChat out, phase Working(Boosting)), close the box, reopen it for the same chat and press Boost (phase Working(Slots)); the old boostChat answer or error lands first
effect: state/domains/groups/apply.rs:295 and error.rs:607 replace whatever phase the new box is in with Main (note 'boosts are reassigned' or 'Could not boost'); the slots answer then finds no Working(Slots) and is dropped, so the press does nothing and the box shows the old request's note
fix: BoostWork::{Slots{request}, SlotsReady, Boosting{request, reassign}}; an answer or error counts only for the request in the phase

title: forget_all_group_offers takes the waiting requests but leaves the stages that wait for them
trigger: set_call_engine (connect/calls/mod.rs:56) runs while a rejoin, screen-share start or conference join is waiting for its payload
effect: GroupCallRejoin stays InFlight{request} for a request that is gone (the auto rejoin never restarts an in-flight one, only the manual Rejoin does), screen_share stays Starting and calls.pending_conference stays pending with no request; finish_offer's undo_offer path is the one that puts these back and is skipped
fix: Drain group_offers through finish_offer with an Unavailable payload (fail_offer/undo_offer) instead of dropping the map

title: request_gift_code_info writes a new GiftCodeLookup over one that is Applying, dropping its request
trigger: Press Apply in the gift code box (stage Applying{request}), then open another giftcode link before TDLib answers
effect: payments.gift_code becomes Checking(new code); the answer to applyPremiumGiftCode is matched against the Applying request, no longer there, so the success or error of the first apply is never shown even though Premium was applied; on a failed send of the new check the box is dropped to None as well
fix: Refuse (or queue) a new lookup while the stage is Applying, and keep the old lookup when the new send fails

title: A commit of live-story Stars that did not go out is treated as never added, but TDLib still holds the pending Stars
trigger: Tap Stars, wait for the Undo window to end while the send fails; the commit batch is removed (commit_failed) and the note says not enough Stars
effect: The local pending amount is gone, TDLib still has the taps pending; the next tap plus commit sends the old and the new Stars together, more than the button showed
fix: On a failed send put the pending reaction back (with its due time), as the stage was before commit_reaction

title: refresh_moved_boost_statuses drops the stale mark whether or not the refetch was sent
trigger: A channel's boost level moves while a getChatBoostStatus for it is already in flight (or the send fails): take_moved_boost_chats clears the cache and boost_level_moved, fetch_chat_boost_status returns Ok(None) for the in-flight request and the result is ignored
effect: The older answer lands and is cached as current; the new level is not asked again until the box is reopened
fix: Keep the chat marked until a request sent after the move has answered (Fetch with a stale variant)

title: refresh_forum_topics removes the cached list, then a getForumTopics already in flight makes the refetch a no-op
trigger: Create, rename, pin or delete a topic from the manage dialog while the first getForumTopics for that chat is still in flight
effect: The refresh asks nothing; the older answer fills the list with the state from before the change
fix: A refresh marks the entry stale so the answer of the earlier request is followed by a new request

title: maybe_probe_channel_membership re-sends getMe from the poll pump after every failed answer
trigger: my_user_id is still unknown, a channel or supergroup is open, getMe answers with an error (no handler for RequestPurpose::GetMe errors in the reducer)
effect: probe_membership_everywhere runs every pump and sends a new getMe each time it finishes, an unbounded retry loop while the chat stays open, with the composer gate unresolved
fix: A Fetch for the account's own user with a Failed variant that is retried by an explicit retry or after a backoff

title: One community full-info fetch is held in three places: the community_full_infos map, CommunitiesState::full_info_failed and the in-flight request purpose
trigger: getCommunityFullInfo fails; want_community_full_info reads the failed set, get_community_full_info reads the map and the request table; the set is cleared only by three reducer sites when TDLib sends news
effect: No bug today; Loading is not a value, so a failure for a community that is then deleted leaves its id in the set
fix: Fetch<CommunityFullInfo> per community id

title: NewChatCreation holds its stage as CreationAsker::{Dialog, Closed} beside outcome: Option<CreationOutcome> and a one-shot photo Option
trigger: abandon_new_chat flips asker by hand from the UI; capture_new_chat and run_new_chat_created each remove or keep the entry depending on asker and outcome
effect: No bug today; an entry whose dialog never calls abandon_new_chat stays in the map for the session
fix: enum Creation { Waiting{asker, photo}, Answered{asker, outcome}, Settled } removed in one place

title: switch_language sends language_pack_id before the strings; a later failed send resets the stage to Idle without restoring the option
trigger: choose_language: send_language_option(language_pack_id) goes out, then get_language_pack_strings or synchronize fails to send
effect: The interface keeps the old pack but TDLib now serves the new one (restore_language_option is only called after a failed answer, ui/language_ui.rs:304, not after a failed send); the note says the switch failed
fix: Send the option last, or call restore_language_option on any Err from send_language_switch

title: A failed older history page on a non-empty window is re-sent from the list render
trigger: Open a chat with messages loaded, scroll to the top, and have an older getChatHistory page fail with a non-flood error; the error calls fail_load (OlderLoad::Failed) and notifies
effect: The row-0 paint callback calls maybe_auto_load_older, fetch_history_for only stops for load_failed() && messages.is_empty(), so the same page is requested again after every failure: a request/redraw loop while the top row stays on screen (the newer side stops on newer_failed)
fix: Stop auto-loading on OlderLoad::Failed whatever the window holds; clear it on a user scroll away from the edge or a Retry, as the newer side and inline_members Paging::Failed do

title: full_rich_loads holds Loading with request None and is written after the send; the answer is matched by chat+message purpose, not the RequestId
trigger: Press Load full message on a partial rich message; a second caller of fetch_full_rich_message (the driver has no in-flight guard, only the UI disables the button) sends a second request
effect: Two requests can be in flight for one key; the first answer removes the Loading entry while the second is still out, and the button re-enables early. No bug today because the only caller disables the button while loading
fix: Insert Fetch::Loading { request: Some(extra) } before the send, skip when one is already loading, and settle by the held RequestId

title: ensure_sticker_set_view_files marks SetFiles::Asked before the downloads leave and never clears it on a send failure
trigger: Open a sticker set view while the sender refuses the first downloadFile (client closing or not Ready), then reopen the same view state
effect: The view stays Asked, so the remaining sticker previews are never requested and the grid stays blank until the view is reopened
fix: Set Asked only after ensure_media_files returned Ok, or reset to NotAsked on Err

title: fetch_emoji_pack_title has no in-flight guard, only a cache check
trigger: Right-click an emoji-pack message repeatedly, or open the menu twice before getStickerSet answers
effect: Every open sends another getStickerSet for the same set while the first is pending (wasted requests); the title cache is the only guard and is written on answer
fix: Skip when requests.has_purpose(EmojiPackTitle { set_id }) is true, as the other once-per-key fetches do

title: add_chat_members in a basic group returns Ok when a send after the first fails, so the rest are silently not added
trigger: Add several people to a basic group while the sender refuses the second addChatMember
effect: The loop breaks, returns Ok(first request), no add_members_failed count is recorded for the unsent users, and the box reports success for people who were never added
fix: Record the unsent user count as failed members (or return the error with the partial result) instead of break then Ok

title: fetch_message_audience begins the audience then returns on the first failed send, leaving later lists NotAsked
trigger: Open a message menu when the viewers request cannot be sent
effect: The read-date, author and reactions lists are never asked and stay NotAsked for that menu; whether the page shows a spinner or nothing for NotAsked was not traced
fix: Mark each list Failed when its send does not leave, or continue with the other requests before returning the first error

title: received-gifts refetch and mutations keep running after the gifts dialog is closed
trigger: Open My gifts, tap Hide/Show (toggleGiftIsSaved) or Convert, close the dialog before the answer; the ok marks gifts_op Stale
effect: refresh_received_gifts_if_stale (called from ingest) sees gifts_owner still Some and gifts_page idle and sends getReceivedGifts for a closed dialog; gift_manage mutations also still resolve the old owner. close_gifts only clears gifts_open, not gifts_owner/gifts/gifts_page/gifts_op
fix: one `GiftsView { Closed, Open { owner, list, page, op } }` enum; closing replaces it whole, so no owner outlives the dialog

title: playlist remove/move changes the list locally, and a send that fails neither restores it nor marks it stale
trigger: Offline or closing client: delete a track from your own playlist, or drag-reorder it; send_json fails
effect: the UI comment says a refused send puts the list back, but local_remove_profile_audio / local_move_profile_audio already changed the list and send_profile_request only takes the request. The list shows the removal/new order until it is reopened; take_stale_playlists only sees lists marked outdated by an error answer, never by a failed send
fix: mark the playlist Outdated (or restore the previous order) in the send-failure arm, or carry a RequestRollback::PlaylistEdit like the poll vote

title: release_paid_send remembers the price before the send went out
trigger: Paid-send confirm box with Don't ask again ticked; the connection is closing so send_json fails; user then cancels
effect: remember_paid_trust already trusted and saved the price for the chat although the Stars send never left, so the next send in that chat skips the confirmation
fix: remember the price only after send_json returns Ok (the held send leaves the guard at the same point)

title: create_managed_bot writes Creating over a createBot still in flight
trigger: A second create_managed_bot call (any caller that is not the Create button, which the dialog disables while creating) while the first answer is out
effect: the stage is replaced with a new generation, the first request is not cancelled, and its answer is dropped by the generation check: a second bot may be created and the first never reported
fix: refuse (InvalidRequest) when the stage is already Creating, so the driver, not the button, owns the one-at-a-time rule; give Creating the RequestId and match on it instead of a shared counter bumped by username checks too

title: proxy ping stage is split between pings (Checking) and a side map of request ids
trigger: Ping a list entry, then edit or remove it (edit_proxy_by / remove_proxy_by drop pings[slot] but not proxy_ping_requests[slot])
effect: no bug today: take_awaited_ping needs both maps to agree before it lands an answer, but the two have to be changed together by hand and a lost answer leaves an orphan request id
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) in pings; delete proxy_ping_requests (the way LinkCheck::Checking(RequestId) already works)

title: checkout invoice is a separate Option next to the checkout stage
trigger: send_payment_form_request / validate_payment_order_info / submit_payment_form each write payments.request, checkout, order_info and shipping_id one by one; only checkout.rs closes them together
effect: no bug today, but a new getPaymentForm overwrites a Ready/Verifying checkout (stage Loading) while payments.request, shipping_id and order_info are reset by hand at each site; shows()/checkout_sending() read request while the stage says another thing
fix: put the invoice (and shipping/order stage) inside the CheckoutForm variants so one value is replaced; refuse a new form while Verifying

title: PollVotersFetch::Loading holds no RequestId; the answer is matched by purpose key
trigger: fetch_poll_voters_page inserts Loading for (chat, message, option); the answer and error arms find the entry by the purpose's chat/message/option/offset, and a load-more page is tracked only through requests.has_purpose_for_chat
effect: no bug today: nothing ties the answer to the request that asked, so a reload that overwrites Loaded with Loading (offset 0) and an older page answer with the same key both land in the new stage
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } and a MorePage-style Idle/Loading(RequestId) inside Loaded, compared on answer

title: UserLinkFetch::Loading has no RequestId; getUserLink answer matched by purpose (free: None)
trigger: fetch_own_user_link sets Loading then sends; accept_link/fail_link set Ready/Failed for any answer whose purpose is GetUserLink { free: None }
effect: no bug today; a stale answer from an earlier box lands in a later one's Loading
fix: UserLinkFetch::Loading(RequestId) compared in accept_link/fail_link

title: quick reply in-flight maps are pruned by the starter, and message loads carry no request
trigger: send_quick_reply_request retains `changing` entries by requests.get(..).is_some() and send_quick_reply does the same for `sending`; ensure_quick_reply_messages inserts Fetch::Loading { request: None } after the send
effect: no bug today: dedupe depends on payload strings and on the request table, not on the answer leaving the stage; the messages load is matched to its answer by purpose.shortcut_id
fix: clear the entry in the answer/error arm by RequestId and store the RequestId in Fetch::Loading

title: hub dialog open flags are bools beside the data they guard
trigger: open_received_gifts sets gifts_open, gifts_owner, gifts, gifts_total, gifts_offset, gifts_page, gift_notice and gift_view one by one; stars_open sits beside tx and tx_selected the same way
effect: no new bug beyond c6-001, but every reset is by hand at the opener and the closer, and they differ
fix: enum per dialog (Closed / Open(state)) replaced whole

title: DeviceLogin::{Idle,InFlight} is a twin of sessions_op's mutating stage for the same request
trigger: Confirm a device-login QR; sessions_op.begin(id) and device_login=InFlight are set together and cleared in three arms (send error, answer, error answer) by hand
effect: Sessions buttons are gated by sessions_busy() = sessions_op.is_mutating() || device_login.in_flight(); the answer is matched by purpose (ConfirmDeviceLogin), not the RequestId, so the second stage adds nothing the first lacks and the two can drift
fix: Drop InFlight: the device link is a ListOp write with a result slot (Done(result)) keyed by the RequestId held in sessions_op

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds a name and target but no RequestId; its answer is matched by purpose
trigger: Upload a notification tone; the answer or error is applied to settings.tone_upload when pending.purpose == UploadSavedNotificationSound
effect: One upload at a time is enforced by the Uploading check, but a late answer of any earlier UploadSavedNotificationSound request would settle the current upload (finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error never compare ids)
fix: Uploading { request: RequestId, name, target }, settled only when the answering id matches

title: Sticker batch progress is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: manage_sticker_sets writes batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending together; finish_sticker_batch_item (session_stickers.rs:41-49) edits pending and one of the counters; nothing clears them when the batch ends or the account goes
effect: A finished batch keeps total/completed/failed from the last run; a new run resets them field by field, and total can disagree with pending+completed+failed
fix: StickerBatch { Idle, Running { total, pending: Vec<i64>, completed, failed } } in one field

title: Stale marks for recent/favorite/trending stickers are bools beside Fetch lists that have an Outdated stage
trigger: updateRecentStickers/FavoriteStickers/TrendingStickerSets set recent_stale/favorites_stale/trending_stale (stickers/apply.rs:99-107); refresh_stale_panels clears them by hand after the send, and masks them with &= when the panel is closed
effect: StickerLists::{recent,favorites,trending} are Fetch<()> with Outdated, yet a second bool says the same thing; reaction_options_stale and gifs.stale are the same shape. The mark and the Fetch stage can disagree (a Fetch::Loading list with the flag set)
fix: Fetch::outdate() on lists.recent/favorites/trending (and a MessageReactionsState::Outdated), no separate bool

title: Sticker panel browse mode is reset field by field at several call sites
trigger: select_sticker_tab (231-233) clears set, selected_set_id and stickers; search_sticker_picker (289-296) clears selected_set_id, set, search_offset, search_has_more, searched, found_sets, found_stickers; search_sticker_category (sticker_categories.rs:56-59) repeats the search half; session_stickers.rs:227 and session_apply_ok.rs:335 clear selected_set_id again
effect: A new reset site that misses one field leaves a selected set, a search cursor or found list from the previous mode (a stale has_more with an empty list asks for a page of the wrong query)
fix: One StickerBrowse enum (Installed{selected,set} | Search{query,offset,has_more,sets,stickers} | Category{..}) replaced whole on a mode change

title: A failed send of the notification-exceptions fetch removes the entry, so the Notifications page render asks again
trigger: Close the client (send refused), open Settings > Notifications: maybe_fetch_notification_exceptions removes the Loading entry on a refused send; notifications_page (ui/settings_window/notifications.rs:46) calls it on every render
effect: Each redraw builds and sends the request again while sends are refused; no Failed stage ends the ask (Retry exists only for a TDLib error)
fix: On a refused send, leave the scope in Fetch::Failed (as for a TDLib error) so only Retry re-asks

title: A refused getActiveSessions send returns the list to Idle, and the calls section asks again from render
trigger: Refuse sends, show a settings page with call_device_prefs_section: needs_fetch = sessions.is_idle(); maybe_fetch_active_sessions cancels back to Idle on a refused send
effect: Every render of the section spawns a task that builds and sends the fetch again (no redraw is requested, so it is wasted work per frame rather than a loop)
fix: Fetch::fail on a refused send; the section asks only from Idle

title: A refused refetch of a privacy rule replaces the held rule with Failed
trigger: Open a Privacy page that already holds a rule (Ready), then fetch_privacy_rules again with sends refused: begin_privacy_load turns Ready into Loading, the send fails, insert(key, Failed) drops the rule detail
effect: The row shows 'could not load' with no value, though the last known rule was valid (Fetch::fail keeps stale data; PrivacyKeyState::Failed does not)
fix: Restore the previous state (or Failed carrying the held detail) when the send is refused

title: Attached-stickers lookup keeps its stage in four places: attached_request, attached_answer (Option<Option<i64>>), a sticker_set_view with set_id 0 as a sentinel, and the loading stage
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets writes attached_answer=None, sticker_set_view=Some(loading(0)), attached_request=Some(id); open_attached_sticker_set finds 'its' box by view.set_id == 0 && stage == Loading
effect: The waiting box is recognised by a magic id rather than by the request; the view is written over whatever set box was held; the answer slot is a nested Option that nothing clears if the box closes before the answer (it is taken on the next open only)
fix: StickerSetViewStage::AttachedLookup { request } inside the view, answered by RequestId; no separate slots

title: activateStoryStealthMode says it is deduped while in flight but sends on every call
trigger: Press the stealth button twice quickly: no has_purpose check precedes session.request
effect: Two requests go out; the second answer's refusal (or success) replaces the first's stealth_refusal slot, so the box can show the wrong outcome
fix: has_purpose guard, or keep the RequestId in a stealth stage and refuse while it is out

title: addOffer has no in-flight guard, unlike approve and decline
trigger: Submit the same Edit Price/Add Offer twice before the first answer: send_suggested only dedupes Approve and Decline (busy)
effect: Two offer messages (each with a Stars/TON price) go to the channel's direct-messages chat
fix: Dedupe AddOffer per (chat, message) the way suggested_post_busy does for approve/decline, or hold the RequestId in the offer box

title: open_money_page returns on the first refused send and leaves the page open with nothing asked
trigger: Refuse sends, open Settings > Money: wallet.money is replaced with open:true, state_fetch send fails and returns; rates, explorer and history are never asked; ui/ton_wallet_money.rs:53 opens the box regardless of the Err
effect: The Money box opens with an empty history (Idle) and no Retry, because the Paged stage was never begun or failed
fix: Send all four reads, marking each Failed on a refused send (as fetch_wallet_history does), instead of returning at the first
